run_validate_constraints: run the script to validate that C- constraints appear in H- hypothesis lines from fairseq output
run_constraint_check: run the constraint validation script on stdin to check fairseq output constraints against hypotheses
run_fairseq_constraint_validation: run the fairseq constraint validator to verify constraints are present in generated hypothesis text
run_constraint_success_rate: run the script to calculate the percentage of constraints found in fairseq hypothesis output
run_validate_fairseq_output: run the validation script to parse C- and H- lines and report constraint satisfaction rate
